wikiPages.title: Bounded Research context
wikiPages.markdown:
# Bounded Research context

The synthesis remains the primary reading surface while related knowledge is previewed beside it.

[[a-related-concept]] links directly from the Topic. [[related-system]] is another direct hop. [[missing-context-page]] remains explicit.

## Reading position

Paragraph 1 keeps the synthesis long enough to establish a real reading position.

Paragraph 2 explains why previews must not replace the Topic.

Paragraph 3 records the one-hop traversal boundary.

Paragraph 4 records stable-ID deduplication.

Paragraph 5 records provenance alongside outgoing links.

Paragraph 6 records incoming Backlinks.

Paragraph 7 records eligible Wiki Page types.

Paragraph 8 excludes Tasks and Research Change Logs.

Paragraph 9 excludes arbitrary Markdown.

Paragraph 10 keeps malformed pages visible as warnings.

Paragraph 11 preserves title and freshness metadata.

Paragraph 12 keeps context grouped by Wiki type.

Paragraph 13 keeps the synthesis mounted under the drawer.

Paragraph 14 preserves the synthesis scroll offset.

Paragraph 15 contains focus inside the preview drawer.

Paragraph 16 makes the background inert while previewing.

Paragraph 17 restores focus to the related-page invoker.

Paragraph 18 supports Escape and an explicit close action.

Paragraph 19 supports rapid previous and next navigation.

Paragraph 20 renders preview Markdown through VaultMarkdownView.

Paragraph 21 keeps safe Wiki-link routing unchanged.

Paragraph 22 keeps Open in Obsidian available.

Paragraph 23 avoids Research Session behavior from successor work.

Paragraph 24 avoids Add or Remove Topic behavior.

Paragraph 25 keeps the Wiki Page as durable synthesis.

Paragraph 26 makes the bounded context inspectable.

Paragraph 27 keeps warnings visible without broadening context.

Paragraph 28 demonstrates a broad Topic.

Paragraph 29 demonstrates a long reading surface.

# Related concept
